title: Chizkiyah ben Gurion or Garon
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Mishnah Shabbat 1:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Shabbat.1.4) in the phrase: “These are among the halakhot that were stated in the upper chamber of Chananyah ben Chizkiyah ben Gurion.” In the Gemara there, [13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.13b.2), “ben Garon.” In Chagigah 13b as cited by Hyman (the passage is at [13a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.13a.12)) and [Menachot 45a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.45a.19) his son is named only as Chananyah ben Chizkiyah. Hyman says that his son Chananyah wrote Megillat Taanit, as explained in his entry.[^2]

notes.text: The son is named Chananyah ben Chizkiyah in the cited passages; that is not an alternative name for the father who heads this entry. The work-authorship statement remains Hyman’s claim.

The linked Mishnah has גריון, and Shabbat 13b has גרון, beside Hyman’s גוריון. Chagigah has Chananyah ben Chizkiyah and Menachot has Chanina ben Chizkiyah. Heilprin has entries for [the father](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1212&lang=en) and [the son](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1512&lang=en), and discusses the attribution of Megillat Taanit in the latter.
